title: Ṣànpọ̀nná sculpture at Ẹbu Ìyá Mọòpó

terrainReference.basis: Retained Terrarium surface at the reviewed photo-fit anchor.

note: A geotagged northwestern photograph shows the turned head, paired raised arms and open front. Fitting the photographed features to the model and comparing the reverse view puts the open face at about 312° true near courtyard marker 44. The bearing and center are estimates from the camera stations and modeled dimensions. Tree cover obscures the exact footprint.
